visualCharacteristics: Pink-to-orange gradient banner with ROSE logo, title, abstract and button beside a card slider of expert sessions with prev/next arrows, closed by an 'Ask Rose' contact card with a bell glyph; band variant is a centred logo, display line and CTA.
contentPattern: Intro row (logo picture, heading title, abstract paragraph, CTA link paragraph) plus one row per card: picture, label paragraph, heading with session link, meta paragraph, optional CTA paragraph; band: one row with logo | text + CTA.
usage: Use to promote the ROSE expert network with a branded banner and a slider of expert session cards, or as a compact closing CTA band.
reuseGuidance: Reuse on hub pages by authoring the intro row and one row per expert session; use band for a cardless call to action.
